A.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtracting when denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions to create like denominators before subtraction.
Tag for mixed-number subtraction if only the fractional parts need denominator matching.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag for borrowing from a whole number; borrowing is a separate operation.
Do not tag for simplifying the final result.

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or a mixed number with an improper fractional part into a subtraction-ready form without changing its value.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a chosen denominator.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when a mixed number is explicitly separated into whole and fractional parts for later subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversions between equivalent fractions.
Do not tag borrowing after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag simple combination of final whole and fraction parts.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the forms are aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts are subtracted separately in a mixed-number problem.
Tag when subtraction produces an intermediate zero or negative fractional part before any borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the step of creating common denominators.
Do not tag the borrowing/regrouping step used to fix a negative fractional part.
Do not tag simplification of the result.

skills.name: Borrow in mixed subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is too small.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to denominator-over-denominator fractional units.
Tag when borrowing is used after obtaining a negative fractional difference.
Tag when the borrowed whole is added to the existing fractional part before subtracting.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when subtraction can be completed without regrouping.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as 0 over a denominator before subtraction; that is normalization.
Do not tag simplification after the subtraction is complete.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or convert a zero-fraction result to a whole number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced by a common factor.
Tag when a result such as 0/3 is rewritten as 0.
Tag when a mixed-number result includes a simplified fractional part.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the subtraction step that produced the unsimplified result.
Do not tag merely writing the final answer if no reduction or whole-number conversion occurs.
Do not tag normalization or borrowing steps.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole-number and fractional parts into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer answer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fractional results are recombined into one mixed number.
Tag when a zero whole part is dropped to leave only a fraction.
Tag when a whole part is combined with a zero fraction to state an integer result.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the arithmetic subtraction itself.
Do not tag simplification of a fraction before recombining.
Do not tag operand rewriting done before subtraction.

C.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions to create like denominators before subtraction.
Tag for mixed-number problems when only the fractional parts need denominator matching.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag borrowing steps that create a whole-denominator fraction such as 12/12; that is regrouping, not denominator matching.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed-number part unless the step also changes denominators to a common one.

skills.name: Normalize mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number with an improper fractional part into a standard mixed number before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number like 2 3/2 or 1 4/3 is rewritten as an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when the solver explicitly states to normalize an improper fraction part in a mixed number.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator.
Do not tag finding a common denominator between two proper fractions.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping during subtraction.

skills.name: Rewrite whole as mixed
skills.definition: Express a whole number as a whole part plus a zero fractional part with the needed denominator to align forms for subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as something like 3 + 0/5 or 2 + 0/8.
Tag when this rewrite is used to subtract a whole from or from a mixed number/fraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag standard mixed-number decomposition that only identifies existing whole and fractional parts.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion between nonzero fractions.
Do not tag borrowing a whole into denominator-over-denominator form after subtraction has begun.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract the whole and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the forms are aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted directly.
Tag when the solution computes an intermediate negative fractional part before any borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag denominator-matching conversions done before subtraction.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that adjust a negative fractional result.
Do not tag simplification of the final fraction or mixed number.

skills.name: Borrow in mixed subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as denominator-over-denominator and use it to resolve a negative or insufficient fractional part in mixed-number subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solver borrows 1 from the whole part to continue subtracting the fractional part.
Tag when a step creates forms like 5/5, 10/10, 12/12, or 24/24 from one whole during subtraction.
Tag when borrowing is used after rewriting a whole number as a mixed number with 0 fractional part.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag direct subtraction when the fractional part is already large enough and no regrouping occurs.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion before subtraction.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed-number part before subtraction begins.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction, remove a zero fractional part, or express the result as an integer or simplest mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced to lowest terms.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0 or when a mixed number with 0 fractional part is written as a whole number.
Tag when the final result is rewritten into simplest acceptable form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the subtraction computation itself.
Do not tag combining nonzero whole and fractional parts into a mixed number if no simplification occurs.
Do not tag normalization or borrowing steps.

B.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Normalize mixed numbers
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number that has an improper fractional part into an equivalent standard mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly converts a form like 2 3/2 or 1 4/3 into a standard mixed number.
Tag when the solver states 'normalize' and rewrites the mixed number to make the whole and fractional parts proper.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator; that is handled by S04.
Do not tag ordinary separation of a standard mixed number into whole and fractional parts without changing its value representation.

skills.name: Create common denominator
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator and convert unlike fractional parts to equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when denominators differ and the solver finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when fractions are converted, such as 5/3 to 20/12 or 3/5 to 6/10, to enable subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag borrowing steps that add one whole as denominator/denominator after subtraction has begun; that is handled by S05.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solver subtracts numerators over a shared denominator.
Tag when the solver subtracts whole parts and fraction parts separately in mixed-number subtraction.
Tag when subtraction is performed after normalization or denominator conversion.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is first creating a common denominator; that is S02.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping because a fractional difference is negative; that is S05.
Do not tag final recombination or simplification-only steps.

skills.name: Rewrite whole as fraction
skills.definition: Express a whole number as a whole plus zero fractional parts with a chosen denominator so it can be subtracted alongside a fraction or mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as forms like 3 + 0/5, 2 + 0/3, or 2 + 0/8.
Tag when this rewrite is used to align a whole number with a mixed number or fraction in subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number; that is S01.
Do not tag borrowing one whole into denominator/denominator during regrouping; that is S05.

skills.name: Borrow across mixed number
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as denominator over denominator and adjust the whole part when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solver explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when a step converts a whole into forms like 12/12, 5/5, 3/3, or 24/24 and adds it to the fractional part before subtracting.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when the fractional part is nonnegative without regrouping.
Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as whole plus 0 over a denominator; that is S04.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or convert a zero-fraction/whole-equivalent result to an integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solver reduces a fraction such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when the solver simplifies 0/3 to 0 or 1 0/3 to 1.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag mere combination of already simplified whole and fractional parts into a mixed number; that is S07.
Do not tag subtraction steps that happen to produce an already simplified fraction without an explicit simplification action.

skills.name: Combine final form
skills.definition: Assemble the computed whole and fractional parts into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer answer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solver explicitly combines separate whole and fraction results into one final number.
Tag when the solver states a final mixed number or integer after prior subtraction steps.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the arithmetic subtraction itself; that is S03 or S05.
Do not tag simplification-only steps unless the step also explicitly combines parts into the final form.
